data.title: 户隐憧子 · 花店门口的两枝花
data.description: 花店门口，憧子把一枝浅紫洋桔梗举到眼前，又看了看桶里的白花。她侧过身，留出位置请你一起挑。
data.promptProse: Touko pauses at a florist in a lavender blouse and charcoal midi skirt. She holds a pale purple lisianthus near her face, glancing toward the viewer beside a bucket of white flowers. Soft daylight from the storefront illuminates the petals and her sleeves.
data.animaCaption: She holds a single stem below the blossom, leaving the other flowers in their bucket.
data.action: 举起一枝洋桔梗请你一起挑花
